chunks.say: What if an alien ship crashed on Earth?
Three twelve a.m.
Radar picks up something falling over Kansas.
Too slow to be a meteor… and it's slowing down.
It hits a wheat field.
Within twenty minutes, the military seals off ten miles in every direction.
But a farmer filmed it.
By sunrise… two hundred million people have seen it.
Every plane in the sky is ordered to land.
The last time that happened was nine eleven.
chunks.cap: The last time that happened was 9/11.

chunks.say: Markets open… and crash so fast, trading is shut down in minutes.
Supermarket shelves empty.
Highways out of every major city… jam solid.
At noon, the UN Security Council meets in an emergency session.
And here's the scary part.
There is no official plan for this.
None.
Day three. A team in hazmat suits finally reaches the ship.
The hatch is open.
And it's empty.
Whatever was flying it… already walked away.
So… where would you go?
